outcome: Characteristics of fetal heart rate tracings after an eclamptic seizure
Obstetrical management following eclamptic seizures complicated by fetal heart rate decelerations
cohort: Women diagnosed with eclampsia (n=107) at a single institution between January 2009 and December 2021
finding: The majority (79%) of fetuses exposed to maternal eclamptic seizures demonstrated prolonged decelerations, but prioritization of maternal support and stabilization resulted in favorable perinatal outcomes without immediate operative intervention in most cases.
